constraints: No free manpower, equipment, horses, supply or combat experience.
Operations, marches and battles require exact materialized actions under the autonomous world contract.
goals: advance supported force maintenance, training and development over real elapsed time
wake exact units, formations, pools or armies when a material threshold is crossed
reconstruction_policy: Use saved force, pool, establishment, training, equipment, logistics and casualty authorities and preserve conservation.
replanning_policy: At each boundary or causal wake, settle supported development only; operational action selection remains with exact campaigns or the autonomous heartbeat.
safe_compaction_policy: Stable homogeneous spans may compact only when equivalent to ordered interval resolution and any material asymmetry splits the span.
standing_orders: conserve manpower, equipment, mounts, supplies, casualties and experience
never turn force or replacement pools into fighting units without lawful organization
